info.title: Robono Voice Calling API
info.description: Use the serviceUrl returned by your calling admission request. All timestamps and durations are milliseconds. Obtain calling access and SDK details through your Robono workspace. Backend admission is documented at /docs#calling. A calling session token is distinct from your network API key.

post.description: Only the controlling device can hold its side. Increment revision for each new intention and reuse the same revision on retry. Older revisions cannot undo newer changes. Holds expire after five minutes; repeated requests do not extend them. Resume rechecks current authorization.

post.summary: Backend admission, same-app permissions, appearance and incoming-call notifications
post.description: Authenticate users in your own backend before requesting admission. The authenticated network owns both user IDs for a relationship; clients cannot register a pair in another network. Calling access is enabled separately in the workspace. For relationship updates, preserve one increasing revision per user pair and synchronize blocks, removal and account deletion.

200.description: Admission grant, same-network calling permission or notification settings, depending on operation.

appearance.description: Validated version 1 CallingAppearance: appName, logoUrl, theme, labels and per-event sounds. See the calling appearance guide.

409.description: relationship_revision_conflict: reconcile with your latest permission record before retrying.

post.description: Optional inventory, never a billing meter. Send after session setup and when mounting optional screens; do not send per poll. No user names or content.

NetworkApiKey.description: Server-only network API key with calling:connect permission. Never put this key in a mobile or browser client.

holdExpiresAt.description: Local acknowledged hold deadline in Unix milliseconds.

ringRemainingMs.description: Remaining ringing duration in milliseconds. Unanswered calls expire 30 seconds after creation.

CallingWebhook.description: Delivered to the receiving network’s signed webhook. ISO timestamps apply to webhooks. Enable through the admission endpoint using operation notifications. See /docs#calling.

connection_id.description: app:conversationId, bridge:connectionId, or network:relationshipId for two users in one connected app.

sequence.description: 1 incoming; 2 dismissed. Retain the highest sequence for each call for at least 24 hours.

reason.description: Present for dismissal. answered clears other invitations without ending the answering device’s call.

CallingRelationshipRequest.description: Backend-only permission for an existing same-network pair. POST to the admission address from the Calling workspace using its network API key. Retry the same revision/value after a lost response; a stale or conflicting revision returns 409. Synchronize blocks and account removal with allowed=false and a higher revision.
